![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LuckPerms/branding/master/banner/banner.png "Banner")
# LuckPerms
[![Build Status](https://ci.lucko.me/job/LuckPerms/badge/icon)](https://ci.lucko.me/job/LuckPerms/)
[![javadoc](https://javadoc.io/badge2/net.luckperms/api/javadoc.svg)](https://javadoc.io/doc/net.luckperms/api)
[![Maven Central](https://img.shields.io/maven-metadata/v/https/repo1.maven.org/maven2/net/luckperms/api/maven-metadata.xml.svg?label=maven%20central&colorB=brightgreen)](https://search.maven.org/artifact/net.luckperms/api)
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/241667244927483904.svg?label=discord&logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/luckperms)

LuckPerms is a permissions plugin for Minecraft servers. It allows server admins to control what features players can use by creating groups and assigning permissions.

The latest downloads, wiki & other useful links can be found on the project homepage at [luckperms.net](https://luckperms.net/).

It is:

* **fast** - written with performance and scalability in mind.
* **reliable** - trusted by thousands of server admins, and the largest of server networks.
* **easy to use** - setup permissions using commands, directly in config files, or using the web editor.
* **flexible** - supports a variety of data storage options, and works on lots of different server types.
* **extensive** - a plethora of customization options and settings which can be changed to suit your server.
* **free** - available for download and usage at no cost, and permissively licensed so it can remain free forever.

For more information, see the wiki article on [Why LuckPerms?](https://luckperms.net/wiki/Why-LuckPerms)

## Building
LuckPerms uses Gradle to handle dependencies & building.

#### Requirements
* Java 21 JDK or newer
* Git

#### Compiling from source
```sh
git clone https://github.com/LuckPerms/LuckPerms.git
cd LuckPerms/
./gradlew build
```

You can find the output jars in the `loader/build/libs` or `build/libs` directories.

## Tests
There are some automated tests which run during each build.

* Unit tests are defined in [`common/src/test`](https://github.com/LuckPerms/LuckPerms/tree/master/common/src/test)
* Integration tests are defined in [`standalone/src/test`](https://github.com/LuckPerms/LuckPerms/tree/master/standalone/src/test).

## Contributing
#### Pull Requests
If you make any changes or improvements to the plugin which you think would be beneficial to others, please consider making a pull request to merge your changes back into the upstream project. (especially if your changes are bug fixes!)

LuckPerms loosely follows the [Google Java Style Guide](https://google.github.io/styleguide/javaguide.html). Generally, try to copy the style of code found in the class you're editing. 

#### Project Layout
The project is split up into a few separate modules.

* **API** - The public, semantically versioned API used by other plugins wishing to integrate with and retrieve data from LuckPerms. This module (for the most part) does not contain any implementation itself, and is provided by the plugin.
* **Common** - The common module contains most of the code which implements the respective LuckPerms plugins. This abstract module reduces duplicated code throughout the project.
* **Bukkit, BungeeCord, Fabric, Forge, Nukkit, Sponge & Velocity** - Each use the common module to implement plugins on the respective server platforms.

## License
LuckPerms is licensed under the permissive MIT license. Please see [`LICENSE.txt`](https://github.com/LuckPerms/LuckPerms/blob/master/LICENSE.txt) for more info.

# LuckPerms Forge  for Minecraft 1.20.1

Vonix Network maintenance release. Matches upstream LuckPerms 5.5.108 on the
Forge 1.20.1 line.

## Compatibility
- **Minecraft:** 1.20.1
- **Forge:** 47.x
- **Java:** 17
- **Loaders shipped in this jar:** Forge

## Upstream tracking
- Fork anchor: upstream `f78e2d6c5` (last upstream commit still targeting MC 1.20.1 on the Forge line)
- **56 upstream commits backported** since the anchor, including the LuckPerms 5.5 API release, adventure 4.17 upgrade, REST storage backend, Redis Sentinel support, Vault "provide" support, and many bug fixes.
- Full ported/skipped log: [`BACKPORT-LOG.md`](https://github.com/Vonix-Network/LuckPerms/blob/vonix-1.20.1/BACKPORT-LOG.md).

## Vonix compile fixes applied on top of the port pass
- `common/DurationFormatter`: `PlainComponentSerializer.plain()` → `PlainTextComponentSerializer.plainText()` (adventure 4.11+ API rename).
- `common/FileActionLogger`: `List.reversed()` (Java 21) → `Collections.reverse(new ArrayList<>(...))` (works on Java 17).
- `common/StandardNodeMatchers.MetaKeyEquals`: missing `this.metaKey = metaKey` initializer added.
- `settings.gradle`: dropped `fabric` and `common:minecraft` includes (upstream had already moved Fabric off 1.20.1 by the anchor, and the shared `common:minecraft` module never existed on this line).

## Artifact
- `LuckPerms-Forge-5.5.108+vonix.1.jar` — drop-in replacement for existing LuckPerms Forge jars on 1.20.1 servers.
- SHA256: `742726680ee1304c496a75d917d1790a5db363940aad239c5519912a15bab930`
- Size: 1451285 bytes

## Install
Replace any existing `LuckPerms-Forge-*.jar` in your server's `mods/` directory with this file. Restart the server. Existing LuckPerms config, storage, and permissions data are preserved.

## Credits
- Upstream: [LuckPerms/LuckPerms](https://github.com/LuckPerms/LuckPerms) by Luck
- Vonix maintenance: Vonix Network

Vonix-Network NeoForge 1.21.1 LuckPerms backport.

## What this is
A NeoForge 1.21.1 build of LuckPerms with:
1. **Imagineer7's capability-init fixes** ([source](https://github.com/Imagineer7/LuckPerms_Custom_Fixes/releases/tag/5.4.145)) — resolves `IllegalStateException: Capability has not been initialised` race vs Balm/FTB Ranks during player join (LP upstream issues [#4183](https://github.com/LuckPerms/LuckPerms/issues/4183) / [#4235](https://github.com/LuckPerms/LuckPerms/issues/4235))
2. **41 upstream commits backported** from luckperms/master onto the last MC 1.21.1-compatible base (`136a4859f`). Highlights:
   - Redis Sentinel support (#4244)
   - NATS auth token support (#4238)
   - Common placeholders module (#4267)
   - SQL Messenger time-column index (#4255)
   - Verbose chat rate-limit
   - SqlStorage duplicate readNode fix
   - UUID mismatch warning suppression (#4194)
   - IPv6 support
   - Adventure 4.17
   - User Housekeeper timeout bump
   - Many more — see [BACKPORT-LOG.md](https://github.com/Vonix-Network/LuckPerms/blob/vonix-neoforge-fixes/BACKPORT-LOG.md)

## Target
- Minecraft: **1.21.1**
- NeoForge: **21.1.x** (tested on 21.1.215)
- Java: **21** (class file version 65 — works on yolks java_21 and java_25)

## Verified
Boot-tested locally on `servercheap` with NeoForge 21.1.215 + Java 21:
- ✅ Standalone boot: `Successfully enabled`, PermissionAPI registered, clean `Done(`
- ✅ Boot with Balm 21.0.59 + FTB Ranks 2101.1.3 + FTB Library 2101.1.32 + Architectury 13.0.8 — the exact mod set that crashed Protocol Zero / Stone Block 4 on stock LP 5.4.140: no `Capability has not been initialised`, FTB Ranks loaded its rank tree from LP cleanly.

## Skipped from upstream
5 commits unportable to the 1.21.1 base (Hytale-only, Folia-only, or hard-coupled to post-1.21.1 shared modules). Full log: BACKPORT-LOG.md.

## Credits
- Original mod: [Luck](https://github.com/LuckPerms/LuckPerms) under MIT
- Capability-init fixes: [Imagineer7](https://github.com/Imagineer7/LuckPerms_Custom_Fixes)
- Backport + Vonix build: Vonix Network
